children: Stifel maintained their Buy rating on Agree Realty's stock with a price target of $81.50.
The price target implies an upside of 19.6% from the Sep 17 close of $68.16.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: Agree Realty has successfully priced $400 million in senior unsecured notes with a competitive yield to maturity, demonstrating their ability to access capital markets efficiently and manage debt effectively. This positions the company for continued growth and stability in its retail property investments.

: The company boasts a robust portfolio of 2,825 properties across all 50 states, including well-known tenants such as Walmart and 7-Eleven. This diversification mitigates risks associated with any single tenant or market and highlights the strength of their net lease strategy in the retail sector.
